notes.title: Scroll the Pain Away v1.1
notes.content:
It's been a while since release, and finally a quality of life patch is ready to go! Exploring the world of magic and characters is easier and more fun than ever!

[b]List of Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Tweaks and additions to character outcomes.
[*] Tracing button in spellbook to help practice tricky glyphs
[*] Improved glyph recognition
[*] Skip intro also skips redrawing stamp for the day
[*] Customers are a bit more patient before complaining
[*] Additional dialogues to indicate... well... a variety of things
[*] Fullscreen mode in element tapper
[*] Easy/Hard mode in element tapper!
[*] Many bug fixes
[*] Details improvements :>
[/list]

We hope you enjoy this update, and if there are any other improvements you'd like to see, please let us know!
